name: @locus/browser-desktop
description: A browser-first, local-agent desktop workspace from Locus.
author: SparkTales Inc.

scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/index.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist/main --external electron --external node:sqlite && tsup src/utility/intelligence.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist/utility --external electron --external node:sqlite && tsup src/preload/index.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist/preload --external electron
scripts.dev: pnpm build:preload && concurrently -k -n renderer,main,utility,preload,app 'vite --host 127.0.0.1' 'tsup src/main/index.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist/main --external electron --external node:sqlite --watch' 'tsup src/utility/intelligence.ts --format esm --platform node --out-dir dist/utility --external electron --external node:sqlite --watch' 'tsup src/preload/index.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist/preload --external electron --watch' 'wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/index.js dist/utility/intelligence.js dist/preload/index.cjs && cross-env LOCUS_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .'
scripts.build:preload: tsup src/preload/index.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist/preload --external electron
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:runtime && pnpm prepare:release-config && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dir --arm64
scripts.dist:canary: pnpm build && pnpm prepare:runtime && node ../../scripts/write-release-config.mjs --require-production && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never && node ../../scripts/create-update-metadata.mjs
